basic_profile.bio: A passionate gamer and anime enthusiast hailing from Shreveport, Louisiana. I'm a college student majoring in Computer Science, which keeps me busy, but I always find time to indulge in my favorite games and stay updated on anime. I'm single and enjoy connecting with like-minded people online. My typical online hours are late evenings, usually between 10 PM and 2 AM, when I can unwind and engage with the community.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have an extensive knowledge of anime and gaming, especially within the Granblue Fantasy community. I started playing the game about two years ago and quickly got involved in various forums and subreddits to share strategies and fan theories. My education in Computer Science also gives me a solid understanding of game mechanics and software development processes.
